data.name: The Fox in the Dandelion Sea

volume.name: The Fox in the Dandelion Sea (I)
volume.description: "Dandelion, Dandelion, ride the wind to a faraway land," the Fox chants.\nAn unforgettable Mondstadt fairytale about a hunter and a fox. The Fox in the Dandelion Sea, an 11-part story, begins here.

volume.name: The Fox in the Dandelion Sea (II)
volume.description: "Be good and stay put." Trapped by a Mist Flower, what does fate have in store by the fox who met a hunter?\nThe story of the Hunter and the Fox continues in Part 2.

data.route: The Fox in the Dandelion Sea
